description: This file defines the Loan class and related functions for managing loans within the ERPNext system, including validation, schedule creation, security pledges, and loan lifecycle operations.

classes.name: Loan
classes.description: Represents a loan entity with methods for validation, schedule creation, and security pledge management.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the loan data before saving.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the loan is submitted.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the loan is canceled.

methods.name: set_missing_fields
methods.description: Sets default values for missing fields.

methods.name: check_sanctioned_amount_limit
methods.description: Checks if the loan exceeds sanctioned limits.

methods.name: validate_repay_from_salary
methods.description: Validates if 'Repay From Salary' is applicable for the loan.

methods.name: make_repayment_schedule
methods.description: Generates the repayment schedule for the loan.

methods.name: set_repayment_period
methods.description: Sets the repayment periods based on the schedule.

methods.name: calculate_totals
methods.description: Calculates total payment, interest, and amount paid.

methods.name: set_loan_amount
methods.description: Sets the loan amount from a loan application if not specified.

methods.name: validate_loan_amount
methods.description: Validates the loan amount against maximum limits.

methods.name: link_loan_security_pledge
methods.description: Links security pledges to the loan if secured.

methods.name: unlink_loan_security_pledge
methods.description: Unlinks security pledges from the loan.
